items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Steve Jordan... for Diana Krall... he’s played with them.

ctx.x: Yes, that’s right. So we’ve been most fortunate. Again, we got someone else, Steve Jordan, the famous drummer for everyone, for Keith Richards, for Diana Krall, for John Mayer, for you-name-it...he’s played with them. I think he played with Velvet Underground at one point.
He’s one of Sonny Rollins’ drummers of choice, when he can get him.
